Antigravity CLI: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Antigravity CLI

No replay has run on Antigravity CLI. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Antigravity CLI.

What the Antigravity CLI setup page says about coverage

Wrap gates the commands you route through it. Antigravity invocations made any other way (an interactive session, the IDE surface, an unwrapped script) never touch KYA. Coverage is exactly the set of invocations you wrap, no more.

Source: the Antigravity CLI recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
